contract: UI language support must be data-driven and must not be narrowed by a hard-coded locale whitelist.
A feature change may add locales but may not remove an existing locale without an explicit approved migration.
Stored user locale must survive reload when the locale is present in the locale bundle.
Locale fallback must preserve functionality and must never silently rewrite the supported-locale registry.
Non-Chinese questions may be answered in the seeker's language.
Persona packs cannot override platform language rules.
Custom decks remain loadable without being overwritten by the built-in LeopardCat manifest.
Custom decks inherit shared reading, orientation and sharing behavior.
Follow-up questions must interpret the same immutable symbolic result rather than redraw it.
A reversed card remains visibly reversed in generated share output.
Questions and AI answers are not persistently stored by default.
Free-tier AI exhaustion/error must fail closed and must not silently switch to a paid provider.
